svg.title: khush2802: 174 GitHub contributions, 26 Oct 2025 – 25 Oct 2026
svg.desc: Isometric contribution calendar. 59 active days out of 365. Busiest day 2026-03-11 (15); most active weekday Wednesday. Public repositories: 41. Source: GitHub GraphQL API.
